Since identical question of fact and law is involved in these Review Petitions, all these matters were heard analogously and are being decided by this common order.

By filing the aforementioned Writ Petitions, the writ petitioners were claiming the additional amount of compensation, solatium and interest NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8361 9 RP-372-2026 on solatium in light of the judgment passed by the Apex Court in the case of "Union of India and another Vs. Tarsem Singh and Others [(2019) 9 SCC 304]".
4 . All the aforementioned Writ Petitions were disposed of vide abovementioned orders directing the respondent/National Highways Authority of India to pay additional compensation under Section 23(1-A), solatium under Section 23(2) and interest under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 in light of the judgement passed by the Apex Court in Tarsem Singh and Others (supra) within a period of six months from today.
